title: Genome-wide protein-DNA interaction site mapping using a double strand DNA-specific cytosine deaminase
authors: Larry A. Gallagher; Elena Velazquez; S. Brook Peterson; James C. Charity; FoSheng Hsu; Matthew C. Radey; Michael J. Gebhardt; Marcos H. de Moraes; Kelsi M. Penewit; Jennifer Kim; Pia A. Andrade; Thomas LaFramboise; Stephen J. Salipante; Victor de Lorenzo; Paul A. Wiggins; Simon L. Dove; Joseph D. Mougous
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了基于DddA脱氨酶的3D-seq方法，用于体内全基因组蛋白-DNA互作位点作图，并应用于转录因子结合位点检测，虽为实验方法而非AI/物理模拟建模，但聚焦TF-DNA互作体系，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract: DNA–protein interactions (DPIs) are central to such fundamental cellular processes as transcription and chromosome maintenance and organization. The spatiotemporal dynamics of these interactions dictate their functional consequences; therefore, there is great interest in facile methods for defining the sites of DPI within cells. Here, we present a general method for mapping DPI sites in vivo using the double stranded DNA-specific cytosine deaminase toxin DddA. Our approach, which we term DddA-sequencing (3D-seq), entails generating a translational fusion of DddA to a DNA binding protein of interest, inactivating uracil DNA glycosylase, modulating DddA activity via its natural inhibitor protein, and DNA sequencing for genome-wide DPI detection. We successfully applied this method to three Pseudomonas aeruginosa transcription factors that represent divergent protein families and bind variable numbers of chromosomal locations. 3D-seq offers several advantages over existing technologies including ease of implementation and the possibility to measure DPIs at single-cell resolution.
abstract_zh: DNA-蛋白质相互作用（DPIs）是转录、染色体维持与组织等基本细胞过程的核心。这些相互作用的时空动态决定了其功能后果；因此，开发简便方法来定义细胞内DPI位点具有重大意义。在此，我们提出一种通用方法，利用双链DNA特异性胞嘧啶脱氨酶毒素DddA在体内绘制DPI位点。我们的方法，称为DddA测序（3D-seq），包括将DddA与目标DNA结合蛋白生成翻译融合体、灭活尿嘧啶DNA糖基化酶、通过其天然抑制剂蛋白调节DddA活性，以及进行DNA测序以实现全基因组DPI检测。我们成功地将此方法应用于三种铜绿假单胞菌转录因子，这些因子代表不同的蛋白质家族，并结合可变数量的染色体位点。3D-seq相较于现有技术具有多项优势，包括易于实施及在单细胞分辨率下测量DPI的可能性。
